msg: Hi! My boyfriend has his PADI Open Water and I've never dived. How much would it be for the two of us for one day?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

That sounds like a lovely day in the Rosario Islands! For one day, the certified diver can do **Fun Dives**, while the beginner can try the **Dive Mini Course**.

**Already on the Rosario Islands**

The mini course is a beginner-friendly introduction and doesn’t require prior certification.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊

msg: We're staying at Isla Grande. He hasn't been diving in about 3 years, and I'd like to try the mini course. We're from Canada.
reply:
That sounds like a great one-day plan on Isla Grande! Your mini course is for your first dive. Since your boyfriend is certified and hasn’t dived in about three years, he may need a refresher before diving; it’s a separate paid review, not the mini course.

The mini course includes diving equipment, insurance, and a PADI professional. Pick-up is between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m. if your hotel has boat access, with a return around 12:00–1:00 p.m. Lunch isn’t included. The mini course requires a medical form, and you’ll need to wait at least 12 hours after diving before flying. For the refresher, the post-dive flight wait is at least 18 hours.

I’m sharing the plan details below. Would you like help adding the refresher for him?

🤿 *Dive Mini Course (already on the islands)*
💰 2 × 134 USD p.p. = *268 USD* (online rate)
✅ Includes: hotel pick-up (if there is maritime/boat access), dive insurance, diving equipment and a PADI professional accompanying the activity.
📍 Pickup at your island hotel.

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

_The price is the same in COP or USD, with no extra charge for the currency._

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿

msg: No wait, he's a certified diver, he wants the fun dives with a refresher. Only I'm doing the mini course. How do we pay?
reply:
Got it—he’ll book **Fun Dives with the refresher**, and you’ll book the **Dive Mini Course**. You can book and pay for each activity online using its link. As international clients, you pay 100% by card on the website; with a foreign card, use the passport as the ID document. The 10% online discount is applied automatically.

- **Fun Dives (already on the islands):** https://book.divingplanet.org/book/fun-dives-already-on-island/19?language=en  
- **Dive Mini Course (already on the islands):** https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

Payment is recorded right away, and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking. If the booking system or online payment fails, the team can send a bank-transfer payment link and the online discount is kept; otherwise, payment is by card online.

🤿 *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day, already on the islands)*
💰 *124 USD* per person (online rate)
✅ Includes: hotel pick-up (if there is maritime/boat access), dive insurance, full diving equipment and a PADI professional accompanying the activity.
📍 Pickup at your island hotel.

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/fun-dives-already-on-island/19?language=en<<<SPLIT>>>🤿 *Dive Mini Course (already on the islands)*
💰 *134 USD* per person (online rate)
✅ Includes: hotel pick-up (if there is maritime/boat access), dive insurance, diving equipment and a PADI professional accompanying the activity.
📍 Pickup at your island hotel.

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

_The price is the same in COP or USD, with no extra charge for the currency._

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿
